data.description:
## What
Implement proximity.py with overlap detection and wire it into runner.py to guard Call 2 redispatch.

## Changes
1. plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/proximity.py (new file):
   - parse_cited_line(s: str) -> tuple[str, int, int]: parse 'path:start_line[-end_line]' 
   - ranges_overlap(a_file, a_start, a_end, b_file, b_start, b_end, tolerance=5) -> bool: same file AND ranges within ±5 lines
   - finding_overlaps_prior(finding_cited_lines, prior_cited_lines, tolerance=5) -> bool: any pair of (finding, prior) ranges overlap

2. runner.py: after Call 2 returns, for each NEW_INTRODUCED finding without escape_rationale:
   - Check proximity_overlap against all prior_findings cited_lines
   - If overlap exists: reject finding, log 'proximity-overlap reject', re-dispatch Call 2 once with re-classify message (max 1 retry)
   - Add oscillation guard: if second Call 2 produces same overlapping lines as first, skip further redispatch

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -f plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/proximity.py
- RED tests from test_proximity.py pass GREEN
- grep -q 'proximity' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- make lint passes
data.title: GREEN: create proximity.py + wire proximity-overlap guard into runner.py Call 2 redispatch
